title: Business Analyst
description:

As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills \& Competencies**
* 3\-5 years of IT experience, including 2\+ years as a Product Analyst, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
* Strong experience in Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog management, Jira, and requirements gathering.
* Ability to translate business requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and deliverable solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience identifying root causes through data analysis.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technology teams.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled product development, prototyping, or solution design is a plus.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related techno\-functional field.

* Act as Product Analyst/Product Owner for one or more business\-critical applications.
* Translate business needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs.
* Analyze business processes and data to identify opportunities, root causes, and solutions.
* Manage product roadmaps, sprint planning, estimation, and backlog prioritization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver process improvements and technology modernization initiatives.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies and ensure successful end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and provide clear, timely communications.
* Champion AI\-driven innovation to improve business outcomes and product effectiveness.


**About The Team**
 By joining the team, you will work in a collaborative Agile environment, partnering with product managers, engineers, architects, and business leaders to solve complex business challenges, drive digital transformation, and leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to create measurable business value.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

 Wood Mackenzie

**Main Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Research Associate to join our Gas \& LNG research practice within the Commodities Global Analyst Team, based in Gurugram or Mumbai, India. The role will support the development of Wood Mackenzie’s views across global and regional Gas \& LNG markets, with a particular focus on APAC gas markets and global LNG asset developments.
   

  

 You will undertake detailed research and analysis across the Gas \& LNG value chain, including gas and LNG supply and demand, consumption patterns, LNG supply and regasification projects, LNG contracts and shipping, market developments, and relevant macroeconomic trends. You will track and assess industry developments, identify key market drivers and risks, and translate data and industry intelligence into clear, insightful views on current market conditions and future market possibilities.
   

  

 You will contribute to the development and maintenance of datasets, data models, methodologies and other intellectual property supporting our Gas \& LNG research and products. This will include supporting the Global Gas Model, developing scenarios for how gas and LNG markets may evolve, and creating compelling visualizations and analysis to communicate our views.

As you develop in the role, you will build deeper expertise across Gas \& LNG markets and assets while strengthening your capabilities in research, data analysis, modelling, market intelligence, written and verbal communication, and client engagement.

* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand.  You have a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, and you want to develop an in\-depth understanding of how these markets underpin the natural resources industry and impact our everyday lives.

This individual will own how fund, deal, and investor\-level performance is modeled, calculated, validated, and reported across KKR’s private equity, credit, real assets, and infrastructure strategies. The role is accountable both for the underlying calculation logic, including methodology, mechanics, and documentation, and for the reporting and analysis delivered on top of it to investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Global Client Solutions.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will personally build models and write code while also leading a team of approximately three analysts and associates, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and developing junior talent. We are looking for a practitioner who is credible in the details of performance measurement and equally comfortable explaining a result to a senior stakeholder who wants to know why a number moved. The ideal candidate brings 7 to 10 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, or a closely related quantitative function, with substantial private markets experience. Exposure to credit, particularly private credit, is a strong advantage given the growth of that business.
   

  

 We are operating in a 4\-day in office, 1\-day flexible work arrangement.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Performance Methodology \& Model Ownership: Own the design, documentation, and ongoing maintenance of KKR’s performance calculation logic across asset classes, including gross and net IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, invested and returned capital, Dollars at Work, and levered versus unlevered return treatment. Consume administrator and system\-calculated figures where appropriate while maintaining independent validation.
* Attribution \& Benchmarking: Build attribution frameworks that explain drivers of return and deliver benchmarking and public market equivalent analysis to contextualize fund and strategy performance.
* Credit Performance Analytics: Support credit and private credit strategies with the metrics that discipline requires, including yield, spread, loss and recovery analysis, and average funded balance measurement.
* Reporting \& Automation: Deliver recurring and ad hoc performance reporting for investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Investor Relations, including investor\-facing material. Replace manual processes with automated, tested, and version\-controlled pipelines that are transparent and easy to verify.
* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead a team of approximately three analysts and associates. Set analytical and coding standards, review outputs, prioritize workload, and actively develop the technical and domain skills of junior staff.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as the trusted point of contact for performance questions across the firm, translating stakeholder needs into analytical solutions and communicating results and their limitations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data engineering, technology, Fund Accounting, and Investor Relations to ensure the data foundations, systems, and controls supporting performance analytics are robust and scalable.

* Direct experience in private markets is required, including a working understanding of fund structures, capital calls and distributions, commitments and unfunded exposure, valuations, and fee and carry mechanics

* Experience building reporting and dashboards for senior stakeholders, and comfort presenting figures that will be scrutinized

description:
**Job Description – Operations \& Business Analyst** 




  





**Department:** 
 Business Operations / Strategy \& Operations
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Nutrabay
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Operations / Business Operations
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The Operations \& Business Analyst will work at the intersection of
 **data, business and problem\-solving** 
 .The role will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Logistics, Warehouse, Inventory, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, and other business teams to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and convert insights into structured improvement projects.
 



 This is not intended to be a reporting\-only role. The individual should be able to move from:
 



**Data → Insight → Root Cause → Recommendation → Project → Business Impact** 




 The person will be responsible for driving projects from insight identification through stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Business Insights \& Analytics** 



* Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, anomalies, inefficiencies, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports covering key business and operational KPIs.
* Conduct deep\-dive analysis across sales, conversion, fulfillment, logistics, inventory, customer experience, cancellations, returns, NDR, serviceability, and operating costs.
* Go beyond reporting
 **what happened** 
 and determine
 **why it happened and what should be done next** 
 .
* Identify root causes behind KPI deterioration and recommend corrective actions.
* Segment performance across products, customers, channels, warehouses, courier partners, geographies, and processes.
* Quantify the revenue, cost, customer, or operational impact of identified business problems.
* Develop business cases for improvement opportunities.



  





**2\. Convert Insights into Projects** 



* Translate identified business problems into structured improvement projects.
* Define the
 **problem statement, baseline, business impact, objective, target KPI, scope, stakeholders, milestones, dependencies, and timelines** 
 .
* Recommend solutions based on data, customer impact, operational feasibility, and business priorities.
* Track post\-implementation results and validate whether expected business outcomes have been achieved.
* Continuously identify projects that can improve
 **revenue, customer experience, cost, productivity, turnaround time, or scalability** 
 .



  





**3\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as a liaison across Operations, Product, Technology, Logistics, Warehouse, Inventory, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, and other teams.
* Bring the right stakeholders together to solve cross\-functional business problems.
* Conduct or participate in cross\-functional project and business reviews.
* Ensure stakeholders have consistent visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and dependencies.



  





**4\. Business Performance Management** 



* Track key business and operational KPIs against targets.
* Develop early\-warning indicators for business and operational risks.
* Monitor both leading and lagging indicators to identify potential problems before they materially impact performance.
* Provide leadership with clear, data\-backed recommendations for prioritization and decision\-making.
* Maintain centralized visibility of strategic projects, expected impact, actual impact, risks, and current status.



  





**Major Business Themes** 




  





 The analyst will work across broad business themes rather than being restricted to one operational function.
 


* Identify customer friction across ordering, fulfillment, delivery, returns, refunds, and customer support.
* Analyze warehouse, logistics, inventory, serviceability, and last\-mile performance.
* Improve fulfillment reliability, order\-to\-delivery TAT, delivery success, and SLA adherence.
* Identify structural performance gaps across courier partners, warehouses, hubs, and fulfillment processes.
* Identify cost leakage across logistics, warehousing, inventory, customer support, and operational processes.
* Analyze inventory availability, stock\-outs, ageing, excess inventory, and inventory movement. Identify opportunities to improve inventory turns, allocation, and availability.



  





**Why You Should Apply** 




  




* **High\-Impact, End\-to\-End Ownership:** 
 You won't just build dashboards; you are expected to take projects from data analysis all the way to execution, stakeholder alignment, and measuring financial impact.
* **Cross\-Functional Exposure:** 
 You will work directly with various core departments—including Product, Tech, Logistics, Customer Support, and Marketing—giving you broad operational visibility.
* **Clear Performance Metrics:** 
 The role evaluates success on tangible business outcomes, such as cost savings, revenue growth, and process improvements, rather than vanity metrics.
* **Problem\-Solver Culture:** 
 Perfect fit if you thrive on ambiguity, naturally ask "why" when numbers shift, and prefer a bias for action over long waiting periods.



  





**Why You Should Not Apply** 



* **Not a Pure Data/Reporting Role:** 
 If you prefer strictly writing SQL queries, building Power BI/Tableau reports, and handing off the work without managing people or execution, you will not enjoy this role.
* **High Stakeholder Management Friction:** 
 The role requires pushing back, challenging assumptions, and constantly following up across multiple teams to enforce accountability without formal authority.
* **Ambiguous Problem Statements:** 
 If you require structured, pre\-defined tasks and clear instructions from a manager before starting work, this role will feel overwhelming.
* **Heavy Focus on D2C/Supply Chain:** 
 If you lack interest or background in D2C, e\-commerce, fulfillment, logistics, inventory management, or customer journey funnels, the day\-to\-day focus may not align with your career goals.
* **High\-Accountability Environment:** 
 Performance is tied directly to real business outcomes (RTO reductions, SLA adherence, cost leakage), meaning simple task completion isn't enough to succeed.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





**3–5 years of total relevant experience.** 
 Ideally, the candidate should have demonstrated experience in at least 3–4 of the following:
 



  




* Business or operations analytics
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* SQL\-based analysis
* Power BI / Tableau / Looker or similar BI tools
* Business dashboard creation
* Root\-cause analysis
* Cross\-functional project management
* Process improvement
* Ecommerce operations
* Customer funnel analysis
* Supply chain / logistics / inventory analytics
* Business case development
* Product or technology requirement gathering
* Senior stakeholder communication



 Previous experience owning a project
 **from identifying the problem through implementation and impact measurement** 
 should be strongly preferred.
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will be feeling appreciated and valued for the work you delivered. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers uptill now, and our family is constantly growing.We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
   

  

 This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting\-edge ML/OR models making split\-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re\-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
   

  

 The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large\-scale, low\-latency data flowing through real\-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well\-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
   

  

 What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting\-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end\-to\-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short\-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end\-to\-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real\-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
